reuse.why: Uses the existing db.first query helper, AccountSyncSource type and LinkAccountBaseParams' upgradingId; there was no existing link-guard to reuse, and it does not consolidate the five parallel link functions.

duplication.why: The uniqueness rule is written once in assertBankAccountNotLinkedElsewhere; only a five-line call is repeated in each of the five provider link functions, mirroring their existing parallel structure.

placement.why: The guard sits in server/accounts/app.ts beside the link handlers it protects; the accounts link.ts module would also have been a reasonable home, but this matches where the link logic already lives.

scope.why: Only the guard, its five call sites and tests.

maintainability.why: Clear single-purpose guard placed before any side effect; a future sixth provider must remember to call it since the link functions remain separate copies.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All five link handlers call the new guard; no existing abstraction is bypassed.

disguised_duplication.where: The rule is defined once; per-provider differences are only the provider literal and the account id field.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinkedElsewhere in server/accounts/app.ts holds the whole 'already linked' rule (provider, account id, not deleted, not the upgrading account) and every link handler calls it.
